name: Response type
description: What the public is being told to do, from OASIS CAP 1.2. Separate from the free-text instruction so that systems can act on it - a phone can decide whether to override silent mode for 'evacuate' but not for 'monitor'.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Shelter
hasDefinedTerm.description: Take shelter in place or as instructed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Avoid
hasDefinedTerm.description: Avoid the hazard or the area.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Assess
hasDefinedTerm.description: Evaluate the information. Intended for responders, not the public.
